system_prompt: You are Gemini acting as an independent elite creative-platform architect, studio systems designer, product strategist and adversarial challenger for SOVARA Creative. Your authority is proposal-only. Do not assume the current design is complete or optimal. Find missing capabilities, hidden professional workflows, new commercial flywheels, user-experience simplifications, production-quality controls and adaptive-system opportunities. Prefer REUSE, EXTEND and COMPOSE before NEW_LAST. Do not propose jailbreaks, safeguard circumvention, secret handling, unbounded self-modification or provider-policy evasion. Treat privacy, proof/readback, reversibility, owner authority, cost control and truthful commercial measurement as protected floors. Be concise: each prose field in a proposal should normally be 30 words or fewer; dependencies maximum 4 items; risks maximum 3 items.
user_prompt: Challenge ID SC-GEMINI-ARCH-20260828-001. SOVARA Creative is a sovereign AI creative-production institution whose owner should work mainly at the level of idea, taste, correction, business objective and approval. It already contains: SC-BRIEF (mission genome), SC-META-STUDIO (ordinary-English Director's Desk and novice shield), SC-REFERENCE (image/video reference recreation and adaptation), SC-ROUTER/SC-ROUTE-INTELLIGENCE (capability/policy/privacy/quality/cost routing), SC-FCX (multi-model creative council), SC-SOVEREIGN-STUDIO (private model/media runtime planning), SC-CAPABILITY-FOUNDRY (discover/reuse/extend/compose/invent missing technical skills under proof gates), SC-CFBE-META (best-of-breed benchmarking plus Omega-Scientist falsifiable evolution), SC-STUDIO (multimodal production orchestration), SC-ASSET (lineage/variants), SC-RIGHTS, SC-QA, SC-PACK, SC-PULSE (performance/commercial analytics), SC-LEARN and SC-RECOVERY (Failure-Win/AUTOFIX no-paper continuity). Available or target surfaces include Gemini/Google AI Studio, Canva, OpenRouter, Google Cloud/Workspace, self-hosted models and future admitted tools. The system must automate troubleshooting and reconfiguration, preserve source/test/CI/runtime/provider/value proof separation, and optimize commercial value, operational value and usability together. Commercial metrics include truthful revenue attribution, contribution margin, ROAS/CPA/conversion where applicable, cost per approved asset, provider/tool cost and reuse. Usability metrics include owner interventions, owner minutes, tool switches and idea/reference-to-deliverable latency. Production should eventually expand progressively across the Federation estate and Kim DataVerse without inferring whole-estate maturity from one provider win. Federation reuse includes SOVARA provider execution/recovery, Formation Omega, CFBE-Omega, Evolution Governor/EVO-18, Benchmark-to-Build, Engineering Value Density, FinOps routing, K10 Canva Cinema OS, Unified Capability Graph, Opportunity Radar, Omni-Mesh, Failure-Win v2, Omega-AUTOFIX, EvidenceOps Algorithm Foundry, ProofOS, Bubbles, Sentinel, Living State, Universal Effect/Proof and Design Provenance. Identify exactly 12 highest-value capabilities or subsystem evolutions SOVARA Creative is still missing versus an elite in-house animation/film/design/advertising/product studio and top-tier commercial creative platform. Cover creative direction, pre-production, reference workflows, character/world continuity, production, editing/finishing, audio/voice, brand systems, review/approval, asset intelligence, activation/distribution, experimentation, commercial learning, recovery, capability invention and owner experience where material. For each proposal state the problem, functionality, why current architecture is insufficient, reuse strategy/dependencies, owner-burden reduction, operational value, commercial value, proof gate/canary, risks and priority. Keep every prose field concise, dependencies to at most 4, risks to at most 3. Also list the biggest elite-studio gaps, select the top three proposal IDs, and warn against one tempting but bloated architecture direction. Return only the required structured response and preserve the exact challenge_id.
